Senior Software Engineer – AI for RTL Design & Formal Verification

Join Astera Labs' AppliedAI organization, where we're building the connectivity infrastructure that powers AI and cloud data centers. Our team sits at the intersection of digital and analog design, verification, and AI tooling, tackling the complexity of next-generation semiconductor products at the pace our industry demands. We're looking to develop and deploy AI-driven agents that accelerate RTL and physical design, static analysis, and formal verification workflows. The ideal candidate combines a strong ASIC and software engineering background with hands-on exposure to digital or analog design or verification, and is excited to apply LLMs and agentic systems to real chip design problems.

Design, develop, and deploy AI applications using LLMs, agentic frameworks, and related technologies to support RTL, physical and analog design, static/lint checking, and formal verification flows. Build infrastructure to deploy LLM-powered engineering assistants and multi-turn dialogue systems that help designers and verification engineers debug faster and close coverage sooner. Develop agentic AI solutions for tasks such as RTL rule and lint checking, RTL optimization, bug triage, formal proof convergence, and static verification report analysis; fine-tune and integrate these solutions with existing CAD/EDA flows. Build and maintain design databases and dashboards that combine agentic and deterministic retrieval to surface relevant engineering data and speed up design closure. Collaborate closely with RTL design, DV, formal verification, and CAD/EDA teams to understand pain points and translate them into AI-assisted tooling.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's, Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science/Engineering, or equivalent experience.
4-10 years of industry experience in software engineering, with direct exposure to RTL design, static/lint verification, or formal verification methodologies.
Proficiency in Python for rapid prototyping, with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and software engineering practices.
Experience with LLMs, including fine-tuning, building multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and vector databases.
Familiarity with RTL design languages (Verilog/SystemVerilog) and formal/static verification tools (e.g., JasperGold, VC Formal, or similar) is strongly preferred.
Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional startup environment.
A proactive, self-directed approach to problem-solving and comfort operating with ambiguity.

Ways to Stand Out

Direct experience applying AI/ML techniques to EDA or CAD flow problems.
Proficiency in modern software engineering practices, including version control, testing, and CI/CD.
Experience with formal property verification, assertion-based verification (SVA), or static timing/lint tools.
A track record of learning across disparate domains (AI/ML and hardware design) and combining them into novel engineering solutions.

Salary range is $160,500 to $200,000 depending on experience, level, and business need. This role may be eligible for discretionary bonus, incentives and benefits.

WelbeHealth is a value-based healthcare organization that’s transforming the future of senior care by providing an all-inclusive care option to our most vulnerable senior population. We step in as the care provider and care planner that work to keep our participants within their communities, out of institutions, and cared for like family, all while receiving the healthcare and social services needed to thrive.

The AI Engineer is accountable for building, testing, and deploying AI-powered solutions that address real-world healthcare challenges within our PACE (Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) program. This role will leverage enterprise AI models, not build or finetune them to create intelligent applications such as participant context engines, retrieval augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and agentic workflows. The AI Engineer will stay current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and translate emerging capabilities into production-ready solutions for our business.

This role is different because the AI Engineer at WelbeHealth:

Builds AI solutions that solve real-world healthcare challenges, providing the opportunity to take AI use cases from rapid prototyping to production while developing participant context engines, RAG pipelines, and intelligent applications that can directly support the teams caring for our most vulnerable seniors
Works at the intersection of applied AI, healthcare, and secure cloud technology, with the opportunity to experiment with emerging LLMs, agentic frameworks, and multi-model architectures while solving the unique privacy, security, and compliance challenges of working with sensitive healthcare data

Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days
401K savings + match
Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus
And additional benefits!

On The Day-to-day, You Will

Design, build, and deploy AI-powered applications using enterprise LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini), as well as translate PACE business requirements into production-ready AI solutions
Architect and implement RAG systems that ground AI responses in WelbeHealth's proprietary data, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and compliance with healthcare data standards
Own the full development lifecycle for new AI use cases from ideation and rapid POC development through validation, iteration, and production deployment

Implement AIOps and MLOps best practices monitoring, versioning, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure all AI applications are reliable, scalable, and maintainable
Continuously evaluate emerging AI tools, techniques, and model releases, as well as proactively recommend new approaches that can improve participant outcomes, operational efficiency, or developer productivity

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, AI, computer engineering, or other relevant field; master’s degree preferred
Minimum of three (3) years of hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering, applied AI development, or software engineering with a strong AI focus
Demonstrated experience designing and deploying RAG pipelines, including vector databases, embedding strategies, chunking optimization, and retrieval evaluation
Proven ability to build applications on top of commercial LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) including prompt engineering, structured output handling, function/tool calling, and context window management
Advanced proficiency in Python for AI application development, API integration, and data pipeline construction
Hands-on experience with Azure AI services (AI Foundry, Managed Identities, Key Vault, private networking) and Docker-based deployments in secure cloud environments
Proficiency with Azure DevOps (or equivalent) for building CI/CD pipelines that automate testing and deployment of AI applications

Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with iterative development cycles and rapid POC delivery
Familiarity with HIPAA, PHI handling, and the compliance requirements unique to healthcare technology is preferred
